card_text: The 80-minute drive from Hobbs: which appointments make it worth it, and how to book.

seo.title: Barber for Hobbs, NM: 70 Miles West in Carlsbad
seo.description: Divinely Faded is in Carlsbad, about 70 miles west of Hobbs on US 62/180, roughly 80 minutes. Book on Booksy before you leave Lea County.

tim_questions: Do clients drive in from Hobbs? If yes, the page can say so in your words. Right now it only gives the drive and how to book.

paragraphs: My chair is in Carlsbad, not Hobbs. From Hobbs it's about {{city:hobbs.drive_mi}} miles west on {{city:hobbs.route}}, close to {{city:hobbs.drive_min}} minutes each way, so a visit is a real piece of your day.
Since that's close to three hours round trip, this page is about making one trip cover everything: the right appointment, booked before you leave Lea County.

blocks.heading: The longer appointments.
blocks.lead: If you're driving 80 minutes each way, it can make sense to get more done in one sitting. Times and prices come from my Booksy menu.

items.title: Luxury Grooming Experience
items.body: Haircut, beard sculpt, wash, scalp massage, steam, hot towels and razor detailing in one block of time.

items.title: Color Transformation
items.body: Bleaching and toning to the shade you want. It's a long appointment, so plan the whole afternoon around it.

items.title: Perm
items.body: Volume, texture and movement, set in one sitting.

items.title: Braids
items.body: Braiding styles fitted to you. Booksy shows the current price when you book.

items.title: Signature Cut
items.body: If you only need the regular: haircut plus beard trim or line-up, finished with a hot towel.

blocks.heading: Every cut style, planned from Hobbs.
A short checklist.
paragraphs: Book first. I only work by appointment, and Booksy is where every open time shows up.
Hobbs and Carlsbad are both on Mountain Time, so the time on your booking is the time on your phone.
Saturday is 8 AM to 2 PM. On weekdays I take appointments Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday.
If the drive runs long, text me at {{phone}} before your appointment time, not after.

items.q: How long is the drive from Hobbs to Divinely Faded?
items.a: About {{city:hobbs.drive_min}} minutes for {{city:hobbs.drive_mi}} miles on {{city:hobbs.route}}, depending on where in Hobbs you start.

items.q: Which appointment is worth the drive from Hobbs?
items.a: That's up to you. If you want more than a quick cut, the longer services on this page let one trip cover it.

items.q: Is Hobbs on the same time zone as Carlsbad?
items.a: Yes. Both are on Mountain Time, so your Booksy time is your local time.

items.q: Can I bring my kids from Hobbs?
items.a: Yes, kids are welcome. Book each of them a slot on Booksy next to yours.
